description: Structural repairs to an end gable wall.
decision_conditions: The works approved by this Listed Building Consent must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this decision notice. Reason: To comply with S.51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:Location Plan - 2401-P800Block Plan - 2401-P801Proposed Floor Plan - 2401-P101 Rev. DProposed Elevations - 2401-P110 Rev. DHeritage StatementStructural Survey Report - BG ConsultingStructural Engineering Inspection Report - CTP Consulting Engineers	Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The removal of external render and internal wall finishes shall be carried out solely by hand or by non-mechanical tools held in the hand, without the use of power-driven tools, to safeguard the underlying historic fabric.Reason: To safeguard the character, appearance and historic fabric of the Grade II listed building in accordance with adopted policies.

The local planning authority shall be notified in writing at least 14 days prior to the commencement of works involving the removal of internal wall finishes. This is to provide an opportunity, if required, for a site meeting involving representatives of the local planning authority, the applicant (or agent), and the contractor to review detailed aspects of the proposed works and to allow for a watching brief throughout the period of such works.Reason: To safeguard the character, appearance and historic fabric of the Grade II listed building in accordance with adopted policies.

Notwithstanding the approved drawings and reports, a detailed schedule of works shall be submitted to within three weeks of the meeting as a record of the works and approved in writing by the local planning authority, including supporting drawings and a condition report specifying the location, methodology and materials for all proposed repairs. Unless otherwise agreed, the repair works shall match existing historic materials in composition, colour, texture and finish. All repair works shall be carried out in full accordance with the details as discussed and agreed on site and as set out in the schedule. The repair works shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details.Reason: To safeguard the character, appearance and historic fabric of the Grade II listed building in accordance with adopted policies.

Any elements that are required to be temporarily removed as part of the works, including but not limited to windows and rainwater goods, shall be carefully removed, securely stored, and reinstated in their original positions upon completion of the relevant phase of works. The local planning authority shall be notified in writing within one working day of any loss or damage to these items. The development shall not be occupied until remedial works have been agreed in writing by the local planning authority and implemented in full.Reason: To safeguard the character, appearance and historic fabric of the Grade II listed building in accordance with adopted policies.
